For me it's Cold Days. I love when Harry mixes it up with the faeries and I think Molly is a fascinating character, which makes it a natural for the top of my list. Also it represents a major change with Sarissa and Molly becoming the new Ladies and Harry coming to terms with the fact that he's the Winter Knight. I'm excited for the continuing fallout of all of this in book 16.

While I'd agree with you about Cold Days being a great addition, my favorite has to be Changes. It switches up so much about the series, has some truly epic confrontations play out, like Harry's duel at Chichen Itza, and has some great heartfelt and tearjerking moments.

An admittedly personal favorite moment is the discussion about who everyone in the group would be if they were the fellowship. The reasoning behind comparing Harry to Sam really hit home, because I always felt the same about Sam. That while he was out of his league and not even the center of the grand story, his spirit and determination were more important in many ways than Frodo's roll.
I also really enjoyed changes. It felt like there was some much that was built up for Dresden in that one and all the emotional twists and turns were over the top.
